parsed_json.sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  a.tid,
  d.journal,
  d.year,
  d.doi
FROM assays a
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE a.assay_type = 'B'
  AND a.tid = 165
ORDER BY a.chembl_id, a.tid, d.journal, d.year, d.doi
